name: strata-l40x1
description: Strata cold matrix on one L40S: IQ3_S at contexts 1k/4k/16k/64k/128k and concurrency 1/2/4.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-25 l40x1 matrix wall (both packs); one pack is roughly half

caveats: The 2026-10-25 matrix used the pre-calibration probe: nominal 131072 cells were rejected at ~149k real tokens. The current probe clamps and records calibration, so reruns are not byte-comparable at the top cell.
Prompts are salted, so all cells are cold (reused=0); warm TTFT is the strata-warm recipe.
The drafter was loaded in the historical run; a low decode number without 'draft layer loaded' in the engine log is invalid.
/tmp on the node must hold ~86 GiB for the IQ3_S staging copy, or pass COPY_MODELS=0.
decode_tok_s_p50 is per-stream; aggregate_tok_s includes prefill and is the comparable number at C>1.
